name: Session timeout warning
summary: A modal alert dialog, opened by Vectra.session.warn(), that counts down to sign-out and lets people stay signed in.
description: Call it a minute or two before the session ends. When time runs out the same dialog switches to a signed-out state with a Sign in button, so nobody loses their place without warning.

classes.name: v-session-time
classes.description: The countdown, in tabular figures so its width stays steady.

states.description: Set by the JS on the modal dialog.

api.signature: Vectra.session.warn({ expiresAt, onExtend, onExpire, onSignIn }) => { close }
api.description: Opens the warning. expiresAt is a Date or a timestamp. Stay signed in and Escape call onExtend; at expiry onExpire runs and the button becomes Sign in (onSignIn). Only one warning is open at a time.

keyboard.action: Presses the focused button: Stay signed in, or Sign in after expiry.
Closes the warning and counts as staying signed in (calls onExtend).
Stays inside the dialog while it is open.

a11y: Focus lands on Stay signed in when the dialog opens, and on Sign in after expiry.
The countdown updates every second but is announced only at each minute and at 30 and 10 seconds (WCAG 2.2.1).
Announcements go to a live region inside the dialog, since the rest of the page is inert while it is open.
Escape extends the session rather than ignoring the warning, so the quickest key is the safe one.

examples.title: Live
examples.description: The second button expires in a few seconds, to show the signed-out state.
examples.html:
<button class="v-btn v-btn-primary" type="button" id="warn-long">Warn, expires in 70 seconds</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-secondary" type="button" id="warn-short">Warn, expires in 5 seconds</button>
